segments.title: 第75章 共享耳機
segments.content:
Reigniting the Verdant Years Chapter 75: Sharing Earphones

During Wednesday's lunch break, after the bell rang, everyone returned to their seats to get ready for a short nap.

The early September weather was still scorching hot, but thankfully, the classroom was air-conditioned. Li Luo sat at the air vent, enjoying the first-hand cool breeze.

Fuyizhong truly lived up to its name. Not only were its academics excellent, but its finances were also robust enough to equip every classroom with an air conditioner.

Li Luo vaguely remembered that his high school classroom in his past life only had a few unremarkable fans. If your seat was at the wrong angle, you wouldn't feel a single breeze, and you could practically die from the heat.

Just as he was thinking about this and preparing for a short nap, Yan Zhusheng, who was next to him, suddenly tapped his shoulder discreetly.

"What's wrong?"

"Shh." Yan Zhusheng made a gesture to be quiet, then laid one arm across her desk and rested her head on it sideways.

The next second, her other hand passed a cord over, with an earphone on the end.

Li Luo followed the earphone cord with his eyes and could just make out, under her long hair, that the other earphone was in Yan Zhusheng's ear.

No wonder she didn't tie her hair up.

As Li Luo thought this, he waved his hand. "You listen to it yourself. I don't listen to music when I sleep."

"It's 'Annual Rings,' the version I sang," Yan Zhusheng reminded him. "I recorded a version last night. Have a listen."

Her words made Li Luo realize what was going on.

So it wasn't just a simple case of sharing earphones to listen to music together?

Li Luo had actually thought he was charming enough to make Yan Zhusheng do something so intimate.

Turns out, it was about the song recording.

As long as it had to do with music, she could always maintain a surprising level of passion and focus, just like in his past life.

"Your efficiency is way too high," Li Luo muttered as he took Yan Zhusheng's earphone.

Plugging the earphone into his left ear, Li Luo followed her example, resting his head sideways on his arm, facing Yan Zhusheng.

The two of them looked at each other face-to-face. Li Luo then saw Yan Zhusheng pull out the phone connected to the earphones from her drawer and press the play button.

But as soon as "Annual Rings" started playing from the phone, Li Luo saw Kong Junxiang silently enter the classroom from the back door like a ghost.

He didn't know if it was a passive skill every teacher came factory-equipped with.

No matter their previous personality, style, or type, once they became a teacher, they always learned how to enter a classroom without making a sound.

The kind where you couldn't hear their footsteps at all.

The moment Li Luo saw Kong Junxiang walk in, he was so startled he snapped his eyes shut, pretending to be asleep.

But the next second, he opened one eye, swiftly reached out, and stuffed both Yan Zhusheng's hand and her phone into her drawer.

"Teacher," Li Luo's lips didn't move, but a faint sound squeezed out from between them, reaching Yan Zhusheng's ears.

Yan Zhusheng immediately understood. She quietly pushed the phone deep into her drawer, closed her eyes, draped the jacket hanging on the back of her chair over her body to hide the earphone cord between them, and pretended to sleep.

It had to be said, although Yan Zhusheng was usually simple-minded, she wasn't dumb. At a time like this, her detailed execution was flawless.

And when Li Luo saw Teacher Kong walking toward them, he immediately shut his eyes and entered a state of feigned sleep.

But what he didn't know was that Kong Junxiang had come to find him, the class monitor, about something, and was just patrolling the classroom along the way.

Upon entering the classroom and confirming that the students were napping, Kong Junxiang walked straight toward Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng.

Li Luo hadn't completely closed his eyes; he squinted through a small slit and noticed Teacher Kong heading his way, which made him a little anxious.

But at that critical moment...

A sudden incident occurred over by Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang.

These two clowns were also sitting in the last row. They had dozed off right after the lunch break started, covering their heads with their jackets, seemingly sound asleep.

But as Kong Junxiang passed by their seats, he saw their jackets twitching, and a muffled snicker came from within.

This made Kong Junxiang sense that something was off. He walked to the space between them, glanced down, then let out a helpless smile, shook his head, and reached his right hand in.

"You two, come to my office."

Kong Junxiang was holding a phone in his hand as he walked out of the classroom.

At that moment, for Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang, when a hand suddenly appeared under their jackets, the hair on the back of their necks stood on end.

They yanked off their jackets, and the moment they saw Teacher Kong, they nearly screamed, scared out of their wits.

By the time they came to their senses, Kong Junxiang was already standing outside the back door of the classroom, beckoning to them.

Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang looked at each other, and like two withered eggplants, they dejectedly walked outside.

At this point, Li Luo opened his eyes, watched the two brave warriors walk the path of no return, and then let out a slight sigh of relief.

The song in his ear happened to reach the chorus.

"Counting the annual rings, one by one"

"I am serious"

"Sealing away all my thoughts"

"Dense and packed is my self-esteem"

It had to be said, Yan Zhusheng's emotional interpretation of this song was quite good. It wasn't at all an effect one would expect the usually expressionless Yan Zhusheng to sing.

Thinking that his own sacrifice and contribution played a part in this, Li Luo felt quite gratified.

At least he had put in some effort to help.

To be honest, it was only because Yan Zhusheng didn't care. Otherwise, a song recording service like this, including arrangement and vocals, would have cost a large sum of money.

But Yan Zhusheng didn't think too much about it. After the song in her earphones finished, she blinked and asked softly, "How was it? If there's anything not good, I can go home and record it again today."

"It's very good, perfect." Li Luo gave her a thumbs-up. "This is great. There's no need to go through all that trouble again."

Neither of them were professional artists. As long as it was more or less right, it was fine; a layperson wouldn't be able to tell the difference anyway.

Yan Zhusheng's own singing skills were excellent, and with the emotional techniques she had figured out herself, her version of "Annual Rings," even if not as good as the original singer's version Li Luo had heard in his past life, was definitely not bad.

"So that's it?" Yan Zhusheng was a little surprised, not expecting Li Luo to be done with it just like that.

"That's it." Li Luo nodded. "We'll go to your place on Saturday to record the other song."

"Oh."

"I'll buy some groceries and make you a nice meal at your place then, as a reward," Li Luo added. "Is there anyone else at your home?"

"No." Yan Zhusheng shook her head. "I live by myself."

"So it's a deal?"

"Okay."

"I'll post this song online," Li Luo added. "For the artist's name, should I use your real name or...?"

"Sheng Sheng Bu Xi," Yan Zhusheng said. "My screen name."

"Alright."

Hearing this familiar name, Li Luo felt a moment of daze.

He vaguely remembered that the Douyin account he helped Yan Zhusheng run in his past life had this as its username.

After the lunch break ended, Zhu Yufei and Zhang Guohuang returned from the office, both looking listless. It seemed their phones wouldn't be returned for a while.

"What were you guys doing with your phone during the lunch break?" Li Luo asked curiously.

"Well, it was that book I mentioned to you yesterday," Zhu Yufei said with a sigh.

"It's all this damn author's fault," Zhang Guohuang couldn't help but complain. "He just wrote about the male lead going on a date with a female celebrity, only to run into another female lead, and then he pretended they were brother and sister. We almost couldn't hold back our laughter."

"Totally." Zhu Yufei nodded repeatedly, dissatisfied. "And the bastard ended it on a cliffhanger. What a monster! I can't get my phone back until after school on the weekend, that's still several days away! It's killing me with suspense."

Listening to their explanation, Li Luo's mouth twitched. "What did I say before? I told you to be more careful. Now you've been caught, haven't you?"

Serves you right!

Why are you reading webnovels?

Just study hard, kids.

(End of Chapter)
